summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload math_init.js
details: The package's declared preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the package-local file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line bundle using obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array indirection (helper WV8StW shifting array n7gIxM, character-table decoding via hc1jfK9, _0xXXXX identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with no source form present in the tarball. The file's name is unrelated to the package's advertised jscodeshift codemod purpose and is not referenced by any other consumer-facing code — its only invocation path is the preinstall-fetched Bun binary. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to interpret an opaque bundled payload that Node-based tooling cannot inspect, at `npm install` time, is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: arbitrary attacker-designated code executes on the installer's host as a side effect of installing the package. The Bun runtime itself is fetched from its official publisher, but the executed bytes are the shipped obfuscated math_init.js, not Bun's own code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
